description: This file defines the SqlAttributesStore struct and associated methods for managing attribute data in a Mattermost server, including database queries for subjects, users, and channel members, as well as refreshing materialized views.

classes.name: SqlAttributesStore
classes.description: Struct for managing attribute data in SQL database, including query builder and metrics interface.

methods.name: attributesSliceColumns
methods.description: Generates column list for attribute slices, with optional prefix.

methods.name: newSqlAttributesStore
methods.description: Constructor for SqlAttributesStore, initializes query builder.

methods.name: RefreshAttributes
methods.description: Refreshes the materialized view for attributes.

methods.name: GetSubject
methods.description: Retrieves a subject by ID and groupID, unmarshals attributes.

methods.name: SearchUsers
methods.description: Searches for users based on various filters and search terms.

methods.name: GetChannelMembersToRemove
methods.description: Retrieves channel members to remove based on search options.
